commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none}"; RUNID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"; echo "resolved-run-id=$RUNID"; mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/$RUNID"; echo "$RUNID" > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/current-run-id.txt; cat .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/current-run-id.txt

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/31617043018-1; gh pr diff 1639 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/31617043018-1/diff.patch | head -0; echo "cached rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/31617043018-1/diff.patch

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  echo "snapshot-ok"
else
  echo "snapshot-failed"
fi

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh requesting-code-review >/tmp/ext.out 2>/tmp/ext.err; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "---STDOUT---"; cat /tmp/ext.out; echo "---STDERR---"; cat /tmp/ext.err

grep -n "find_ungraded_claims\|_premise_regions\|UNGRADED_CLAIMS\|def _run\|import bisect\|from section_parse" /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/scripts/check-verified-premises.py; echo "---LINES---"; wc -l /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/scripts/check-verified-premises.py; echo "---HEAD---"; git -C /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow log --oneline -3

printf '## Current Behavior

The fixture was verified against main and confirmed against the base ref.
' > .prflow/tmp/t1.md && python3 scripts/check-verified-premises.py --body-file .prflow/tmp/t1.md --repo-root . ; echo "RC=$?"
git apply --check .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/31617043018-1/diff.patch 2>&1 && echo "APPLIES CLEAN" || echo "apply-check failed"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
